startup_stage.integrity: FNV-1a-32 over bytes 0 through 75, stored little-endian at bytes 76 through 79
startup_stage.authority: diagnostic-only; never process-event, generation, module, handle, or read authority
startup_stage.freshness: controller truncates this exact path and verifies a zero-byte read before each target launch

stages.name: main-entered
stages.meaning: target main entered and published before module introspection or a gate syscall

stages.name: wrong-caller-open-complete
stages.meaning: target-side OpenExactFixture returned; expected code is -12

stages.name: layout-write-complete
stages.meaning: layout write completed or was explicitly skipped after lookup failure

stages.name: prompt-ready
stages.meaning: all pre-input target work completed and input sampling was configured

stages.name: cross-observed
stages.meaning: the target observed the single bounded X press; controller launch has not yet returned

stages.name: controller-launch-complete
stages.meaning: the target's controller-resume launch call returned; inspect controller_launch_result

local_status_codes.-4601: operation deliberately skipped after an earlier diagnostic failure
local_status_codes.-4602: self module was available but the sentinel was not found in a bounded segment
local_status_codes.-4603: a file write returned zero before the fixed payload completed
local_status_codes.-4604: a bounded record or fixture serialization failed

prelaunch_freshness: Before each generation the controller truncates and verifies zero bytes at ux0:data/vitacheat-foreign-target-layout.bin.
Before each generation the controller truncates and verifies zero bytes at ux0:data/vitacheat-foreign-target-startup.bin.
Before each generation the controller truncates and verifies zero bytes at ux0:data/vitacheat-foreign-target-fixture.json.
Any cleanup/open/close/readback failure is recorded and stops before launch.
run: Allow the controller to verify target-unavailable, clear all three target evidence paths, and launch VCFT00001.
Poll the startup-stage path read-only. Preserve every distinct invalid/partial byte sequence and continue polling without input.
Require one complete valid prompt-ready record with exact build/title/schema identity, sentinel result 0, wrong-caller result -12, layout result 0, and fixture result 0.
Require the exact 32-byte layout and complete fixture JSON independently; the startup record alone is never target-start or read authority.
Send exactly one documented bounded input: press cross; wait 100ms; release cross.
Allow VCFC00001 to require kernel TARGET_STARTED, read, destroy only VCFT00001, and verify the stale handle.
Allow VCFC00001 to clear all three target evidence paths and relaunch VCFT00001.
Repeat the prompt-ready validation and one bounded X input for generation 2.
Retrieve controller JSON, fixture JSON, startup records/partials, layouts, and all available serial lines beginning VCFG.

missing, stale, corrupt, or truncated required evidence
hang, reboot, service loss, or callback anomaly
recovery: Hold L during boot to bypass taiHEN plugin loading if necessary.
Remove only the exact kernel config line.
Remove VCFT00001 and VCFC00001 normally through LiveArea.
Reboot twice and verify normal operation.
